say:1:1330208001:1.text: I enjoy peace more than the excitement of the festival now.
say:1:1330208001:1.source_cn: 因为相较于吵闹的祭典，现在的我喜欢清净。
say:1:1330208001:1.male: I enjoy peace more than the excitement of the festival now.
say:1:1330208001:1.female: I enjoy peace more than the excitement of the festival now.

say:2:1330208002:1.text: You'll get what I mean once you reach my age.
say:2:1330208002:1.source_cn: 到了我这个年纪你就会明白，这样的热闹或许已经不再适合你。
say:2:1330208002:1.male: You'll get what I mean once you reach my age.
say:2:1330208002:1.female: You'll get what I mean once you reach my age.

say:3:1330208003:1.text: Go ahead to the festival and enjoy the fun while you're still young!
say:3:1330208003:1.source_cn: 快去祭典吧，趁着年轻，多去享受这份喧嚣。
say:3:1330208003:1.male: Go ahead to the festival and enjoy the fun while you're still young!
say:3:1330208003:1.female: Go ahead to the festival and enjoy the fun while you're still young!
